region.ui:help: Select the Azure region where your VM will be deployed. The instance picker is filtered by the selected region.

operatingSystem.ui:help: Choose between Linux and Windows. Windows pricing may include license charges unless Azure Hybrid Benefit is enabled.

linuxType.ui:help: Select the Linux distribution or software variant. Ubuntu is free; Red Hat, SUSE, Ubuntu Pro, and SQL variants may add software licensing charges.

tier.ui:help: Select the VM tier. Standard offers full VM capabilities; Basic is available only for limited older size families.

instanceSelector.ui:title: Instance Selection
instanceSelector.ui:help: Select the VM category, series, and size. Options are loaded dynamically from the VM instance catalog for the selected region, OS, Linux type, and tier.

count.ui:help: Total number of VM instances to price.

hours.ui:help: Average hours per month the VM will be running. 730 hours is approximately a full month.

addHybridBenefit.ui:help: Enable Azure Hybrid Benefit when you have eligible Windows Server or SQL Server licenses. Windows only.

managedDisks.ui:title: Managed Disks
managedDisks.ui:help: Configure optional managed disk storage charges. Storage transaction pricing is handled separately below.

redundancy.ui:help: Select locally redundant or zone-redundant storage.

count.ui:help: Number of managed disks to price.

storageTransactions.ui:title: Storage Transactions
storageTransactions.ui:help: Configure optional transaction charges for Standard HDD and Standard SSD disks. Premium SSD has no transaction charge.

transactionUnits.ui:help: Transaction units per month. One unit equals 10,000 transactions.

bandwidth.ui:title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.ui:help: Configure optional outbound bandwidth charges for inter-region or internet egress traffic.

dataTransferType.ui:help: Select inter-region transfer or internet egress.

egressGB.ui:help: Outbound data transfer volume in GB.
